channels.name: Event Planning Blueprint
channels.description: Melanie Woodward, 15+ years planning events for Honda, HGTV and Fortune 500 companies, managed events with 30,000+ attendees. Channel exists specifically to help people 'start your event planning business today' — client acquisition, pricing, avoiding common business mistakes.
channels.focus: Event planning business — clients, pricing, growth
channels.verificationMethod: Extremely well corroborated across 8+ independent sources (Social Tables' and FeedSpot's event-planner-channel roundups, InEvent interview, LiveAbout bio, a PR Newswire release, and the channel's own About page) all describing the same person, career history, and channel.

notes: Real, rich Nigeria-specific business content exists (ConnectNigeria has multiple detailed 2026 articles: full pricing breakdowns by event type and city, and a specific 'How To Start an Event Planning Business in Nigeria: Registration to First Client' guide) but RSS not checked this round given time already spent on the channel search. Worth checking articles.connectnigeria.com's feed directly in a future pass — it's likely the same source already confirmed real for Barbing's blog research earlier.
